question: By what measure and means is the pavilion-related thread arrangement specified?
premises: The measure is by the wrapping measure of the pavilion.
It is done from/by a single thread.
inference: According to the pavilion’s wrapping measure, it is made from a single thread.
uncertainties: Exact ritual object of eka-sūtrataḥ is implied.
plain_english: By the measure of the pavilion’s wrapping, from a single thread.
